_doc: Jobs for `python -m qa build`. One job = one (mushaf, asset type). 'page' is the PDF page (1-based). 'pick' = which detected occurrence becomes the canonical asset (0 = top-most). 'box' = manual [x0,y0,x1,y1] in page pixels to bypass detection. Per-job 'detect'/'clean'/'vectorize' dicts override the defaults below.

jobs._note: Running vine has 180-degree rotational symmetry; preserve its handedness after cleaning.
